title: Reform Sydney Airport slot rules and open poorly served air routes
action: Commission a public review of the Sydney Airport slot management scheme, including how slots are allocated and whether incumbents keep slots they under-use, and allow foreign airlines to carry passengers on poorly served routes and all air cargo, through a permit system if needed.
why: Slot rules that let incumbents keep valuable peak slots make it hard for new airlines to enter the busiest routes, sustaining the domestic duopoly and higher fares.

evidence.quote: The Australian Government should commission a public review of the Sydney Airport Slot Management Scheme 2013 (Cwlth)

evidence.source: Competition Policy Review: Final Report (Harper review)
evidence.quote: The current air cabotage restrictions should be removed for all air cargo as well as passenger services to specific geographic areas, such as island territories and on poorly served routes

progress.what: Slot management reforms at Sydney Airport took effect in 2025.
